effect_description_eng:
[When Attacking] You may play 1 [Diaboromon] Token without paying the cost. (Digimon/Cost 14/Lv.6/White/Mega/Unknown/Unidentified/3000 DP)
[All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, you may delete one of your other [Diaboromon] to prevent this Digimon from being deleted.
